copy.curiosityHook: Behind the routine of boarding school life lies a hidden truth that could upend the boys' fragile world.
copy.description: At a provincial Catholic boarding school in Nazi-occupied France, two precocious boys form a close bond, sharing daily life until a concealed secret threatens the fragile sanctuary around them.
copy.vibeSummary: Deliberate, heavy, and emotionally demanding, offering a reflective solo watch set against wartime France.
copy.whyWatch: Drawn from director Louis Malle’s childhood memories, this drama delivers a deliberate, deeply felt look at wartime companionship shaped by quiet courage and vulnerability.
